name: Gurvin — Female

traits.name: Heightened Senses
traits.description: Gurvin have a keener sense of smell than humans: DM+1 to Recon and Survival checks based on scent. Their eyes are suited to brighter light but worse in the dark — DM-1 to checks requiring sight in dark conditions.

traits.name: Extra Limbs
traits.description: Gurvin have a pair of intermediary limbs usable equally as arms or legs. Used as legs, their movement increases to 8 metres.

source: Aliens of Charted Space Vol. 4, Mongoose Publishing
